title: Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits
description: Supplementary agreement to the Convention on Biological Diversity establishing legally binding obligations for prior informed consent (PIC) and mutually agreed terms (MAT).

title: Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) 1992 Text
description: Parent treaty establishing national sovereign rights over biological resources and traditional knowledge.

title: FAO International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ITPGRFA)
description: Global multilateral system of access and benefit-sharing for plant genetic resources crucial for agriculture.
